question: Which of the following is declared as a Wild Ass Sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rann of Kachchh.**__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Rann of **Kachchh is** located in the state of **Gujarat** in India.
 
• The **Wild Ass Sanctuary** in Rann of Kachchh is home to the **endangered Indian Wild Ass**, also known as the **Ghudkhur**.
 
• The sanctuary spans across an area of **5,000 sq km** and also houses other species like desert fox, wolf, and chinkara.
 
• The **Wildlife Protection Act of 1972** applied to the wildlife sanctuary when it was **established** in **1972**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunderbans:**

 
 
• It is located in the** delta region** of the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
• **It** is a **mangrove forest** and declared as a** UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• It is home to the **Royal Bengal Tiger** and other species like s**altwater crocodile, Indian python, and spotted deer**.
 
 
 
• **Ladakh:**
 
 
• It is located in the** northernmost** region of India.
 
• It is known for its unique culture, **high altitude lakes,** and stunning landscapes.
 
• It is also home to rare species like the s**now leopard, Tibetan wolf, and Himalayan griffon**.
 
 
 
• **Spiti Valley:**
 
 
• It is located in the** Himalayan region.**
 
• It is known for its rugged terrain and **Buddhist monasteries.**
 
• It is home to rare species like the **Himalayan ibex**, **snow leopard, and Tibetan wolf**.
